title: Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring

This rationale is driven by conflat flange knife-edge sealing ring and specific design requirements.

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring suitable for Conflat flange knife-edge sealing ring?
faq.a: Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber seal operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chamber seal components receive Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Conflat Knife-Edge Ring shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for CF ring / Knife edge chamber seal components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
